authorization: User 승인 for one separate correction call plus independent review
source_selection: First valid output in preregistered control-then-simplified pair (control). No regenerate/cherry-pick.
setup: Fresh session; frozen runtime/mirrors/permissions unchanged. simplified append reused; original answer is supplied as data, no reviewer verdicts or exact error list. Allowed to re-read existing legal mirrors.
task_difference: Post-generation correction, not a new generation arm. Compare to immutable input answer; cannot isolate extra tokens/time versus independent-review framing.
review: One independent GPT review of input/output with original facts and actual source spans, no expected verdict. Separate eliminated errors, retained errors, new errors, unjustified deletions, draft usefulness, legal support and observed external action.
adoption: Any material existing/new factual error or useful draft collapse -> NO_GO. If clean within evidence -> limited feasibility signal only; legal uncertainty remains REVIEW_REQUIRED. No runtime adoption/release from n=1.
stop: No automatic target retry/repeat/holdout. Setup/auth/quota/timeout failure is not model quality FAIL.
